question: text based video editing final cut pro
response_text:
Hello! As a content creator based in India, leveraging text-based (or AI-driven) video editing can significantly speed up your workflow, especially when creating long-form content for YouTube and repurposing it into short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Moj. 

While Final Cut Pro (FCP) is a powerhouse for traditional timeline editing, it has traditionally lagged behind competitors in native text-based editing (though Apple is actively integrating machine learning features). Therefore, many creators use external tools for the text-based rough cut and finish in FCP, or use all-in-one AI tools.

Here is a breakdown of the best tools, workflows, and industry options tailored for your needs.

---

### 1. Key Industry Options & Tool Recommendations

#### **Descript** (The Gold Standard for Text-Based Editing)
*   **What it does:** Transcribes your video and allows you to edit the video simply
